title: GraphSupersessionRecord Contract
description: OD-05: superseded graph versions remain immutable history. A supersession record references versions and its originating revision decision; it never embeds or rewrites past execution evidence. S11: when a supersession changes the harness context, context_change records the transition (from_context, to_context) with its own evidence_ref; a context change without evidence fails closed (CONTEXT_SWITCH_UNEVIDENCED) and no default-context fallback exists.
